title: Walmart Leans on Value and AI for Holidays
summary: Walmart says shoppers remain resilient but are being thoughtful about holiday spending, seeking value on everything from meals and toys to fashion and beauty. On Bloomberg This Weekend, Walmart Chief Merchandising Officer Julie Barber tells host Lisa Mateo how the retailer is using its Sparky AI assistant to help customers research gifts, plan meals and shop more conveniently. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Musk Says Google Interested in Renting More Compute from SpaceX
summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google has expressed interest in renting more computing capacity from SpaceX, Elon Musk said on social media early Saturday without elaborating.

title: United Fidelity Shut in Biggest US Bank Failure in Two Years
summary: US federal regulators closed down Indiana-based United Fidelity Bank on Friday after finding the lender was likely unable to pay its obligations, the country’s largest bank failure in two years.

title: Thailand to Ban Export of Chemicals to Myanmar Rare-Earth Mines
summary: Thailand is set to issue a ban on Monday on exports of chemicals used in rare-earth mining in Myanmar, after elevated arsenic levels in rivers in the north raised a public health alarm.

title: OpenAI Says Apple Pressured Suppliers to Shun Its Devices
summary: The trade-secrets fight between OpenAI and Apple Inc. is widening, with the artificial intelligence company accusing the iPhone maker of undermining its supplier relationships and using unfair employment agreements to prevent talent from jumping ship.

title: Bots de compras con IA amenazan el dominio de Amazon y Google
summary: Google, Amazon, Meta y OpenAI compiten por ayudarte a elegir los regalos de Navidad. ¿A quién escucharán los compradores?

title: Nvidia Blackwell Tech Used at China Site Tied to Alice Huang
summary: A pair of Chinese firms installed Nvidia Corp.’s powerful Blackwell semiconductors in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, the woman at the heart of a controversy surrounding the US chipmaker.

title: Verizon in Talks to Buy Fidium in $6 Billion Deal, FT Says
summary: Verizon Communications Inc. is in talks to buy the broadband operator Fidium in a $6 billion deal, the Financial Times reported, a move that would expand its network and allow the mobile giant to target more internet service subscribers across the US.
